_comment: Media files for each company. Put files into assets/<company>/ and list them here. `src` is the path relative to the assets/ folder, starting with /. Supported types: image, video. Example: put demo.jpg into assets/navio/ and add { "type": "image", "src": "/navio/demo.jpg", "caption": { "en": "...", "ru": "..." } }
